mapper.select: /* SQL ID : ExrcsSddnQstnBscDAO.exrcsSddnQstnBscSelect 설 명 : 연습돌발문항기본조회 */ SELECT QSTN.EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID , QSTN.SBJCT_ID , QSTN.QSTN_TTL , DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(QSTN.QSTN_CTS, 4000, 1) AS QSTN_CTS , QSTN.QSTNS_CMPTNYN , QSTN.QSTN_GRP_ID , QSTN.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , (SELECT LISTAGG(SBJCT_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SBJCT_ID) FROM TB_LMS_EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC WHERE QSTN_GRP_ID = QSTN.QSTN_GRP_ID GROUP BY QSTN_GRP_ID) AS SBJCT_IDS , (SELECT QSTN_ID FROM TB_LMS_QSTN WHERE DELYN = 'N' AND EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID = QSTN.EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS QSTN_ID , SBJCT.SBJCTNM , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NO , CHRT.DGRS_YR , CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , CHRT.SMSTR_CHRTNM , CHRT.ORG_ID , (SELECT ORGNM FROM TB_LMS_ORG WHERE ORG_ID = CHRT.ORG_ID) AS ORGNM FROM TB_LMS_EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC QSTN JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON QSTN.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND SBJCT.USEYN = 'Y' AND SBJCT.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT CHRT ON SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE QSTN.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND QSTN.EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID = #{exrcsSddnQstnBscId} AND QSTN.QSTN_GBNCD = #{qstnGbncd}

/* SQL ID : ExrcsSddnQstnBscDAO.exrcsSddnQstnBscListByGrpId 설 명 : 연습돌발문항기본동일그룹목록 */ SELECT * FROM TB_LMS_EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC WHERE DELYN = 'N' AND ( EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID = #{exrcsSddnQstnBscId} OR ( QSTNS_CMPTNYN = 'N' AND QSTN_GRP_ID = ( SELECT QSTN_GRP_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC WHERE EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID = #{exrcsSddnQstnBscId}) ) )

/* SQL ID : ExrcsSddnQstnBscDAO.qstnCopyExrcsQstnList 설 명 : 문제가져오기연습문제목록조회 */ SELECT EXRCS.EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID , EXRCS.QSTN_TTL FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT JOIN TB_LMS_EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC EXRCS ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = EXRCS.SBJCT_ID AND EXRCS.DELYN = 'N' AND EXRCS.QSTNS_CMPTNYN = 'Y' WHERE SBJCT.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJCT.USEYN = 'Y' AND SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}
